summary: GSK plc files a Form 6-K reporting open-market share repurchases under its existing buyback program. Between 26 and 29 May 2026, it bought 1,248,271 ordinary shares at a VWAP of ~1,919 GBp per share, all held as treasury. Purchases are made via Citigroup Global Markets under a non-discretionary agreement dated 8 May 2026. Post-purchase, treasury shares represent 6.57% of voting rights. This is a routine disclosure of an ongoing capital return program, not a tender offer or special dividend. What to watch: the pace of buybacks; no structural premium or risk-arb angle.
